meta.portco: Fair Harbor (NYC datelines; owned store at Prince St, SoHo, Manhattan)
meta.description: All recorded property sales in New York County (Manhattan) over the rolling 12 months, the county of Fair Harbor's flagship owned store and its New York City customer base.
meta.method: NYC Department of Finance 'NYC Citywide Rolling Calendar Sales' (Socrata usep-8jbt) filtered borough='1' (Manhattan), paged 10,000 rows. use_type from building_class_category (01-04 family homes, 09/10 co-ops, 12/13/15/17 condos = residential; 07/08/14 rentals = multifamily). arms_length = price >= $10,000 (DOF records $0/nominal transfers between related parties). lat/lon = 2023 Census Gazetteer ZCTA internal point for the sale's ZIP (geo_precision 'zip'). Owner names are not published by DOF.
caveats: Rolling file covers exactly the last 12 published months (Sept 2025 - Aug 2026); DOF updates monthly.
Coordinates are ZIP centroids, not parcels: use for neighborhood-level mapping only.
Co-op sales are share transfers recorded by DOF; gross_square_feet is blank for most co-op and condo unit sales.

Fair Harbor's other served counties are not covered: Westchester (Larchmont HQ; no open sales API) and Palm Beach County FL (Palm Beach Gardens store; county appraiser has no open bulk API). Next pull: Westchester County Clerk / Palm Beach PAPA exports or ATTOM.
meta.relevance_to_portco: Manhattan high-end residential turnover is a proxy for the affluent, coastal-weekend customer Fair Harbor sells to, and ZIP-level sales density around SoHo helps size local clienteling, pop-ups and wholesale doors.

failed_sources.source: Westchester County (Larchmont HQ) and Palm Beach County FL (store 2)
